ports.name: readout
ports.location: Applicable rear block/entity readout, including contextual rules.

behavior.description: For direct power inputs, compare mode passes rear R when R >= max(L,S), otherwise zero; subtract mode computes max(R-max(L,S),0). Block readout precedence is a separate contract.
limitations: Fixtures sample rear=12 with side=0, 8, or 15 in one orientation.
Equal inputs, two active sides, all input levels, readout precedence, and pulse timing remain pending.

physical.description: Requires support and distinct rear/side/front geometry; readable block reach must be modeled explicitly.
